title: Uniform Inference for Parameters Identified by Conditional Quantile Restrictions
abstract: arXiv:2609.23303v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many structural and dynamic economic models imply that key parameters are identified by conditional quantile restrictions. Building on the exponential-weighting approach of Bierens (1990) and recent advances in penalized maximum statistics for conditional moment restrictions (Chen et al., 2025), we develop a unified inference framework for such parameters. We propose an adaptive $\ell_1$-penalized supremum statistic that transforms the conditional restriction into a continuum of unconditional moment conditions and aggregates evidence across quantile indices. The penalty regularizes the maximization over the weighting direction. Under the stated uniformity conditions, the known-parameter adaptive selector has no lower maximin local power than the unpenalized test and yields a strict maximin local-power gain whenever some positive candidate penalty has a strictly larger population maximin criterion than the zero penalty. translated_title: 由条件分位数限制识别的参数的一致推断
translated_abstract: 许多结构性和动态经济模型都意味着关键参数是由条件分位数限制识别的。基于 Bierens (1990) 的指数加权方法以及条件矩限制下惩罚极大统计量的最新进展 (Chen et al., 2025)，我们为此类参数开发了一个统一的推断框架。我们提出了一种自适应 $\ell_1$-惩罚上确界统计量，它将条件限制转化为一个连续统的无条件矩条件，并在分位数指标之间聚合证据。惩罚项对加权方向上的最大化起正则化作用。在给定的一致性条件下，已知参数情形下的自适应选择器的极大极小局部功效不低于未惩罚的检验，并且当存在某个正的候选惩罚的总体极大极小准则严格大于零惩罚时，还能带来严格的极大极小局部功效增益。我们将该理论进一步扩展……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文基于指数加权方法提出一种自适应 $\ell_1$-惩罚上确界统计量，为条件分位数限制识别的参数建立了统一的推断框架，并证明其在极大极小局部功效上不劣于未惩罚检验，且在特定条件下可获得严格的功效提升。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a unified inference framework for parameters identified by conditional quantile restrictions by proposing an adaptive $\ell_1$-penalized supremum statistic, which achieves maximin local power no lower than the unpenalized test and strictly greater power under certain conditions.
